description: Source-authored relevance judgments fixed independently of retrieval output. Parent-scope queries measure deferred functionality.

documents.heading: Session expiration
documents.body: Sessions expire after thirty minutes without activity. A refresh token can renew the login session.

documents.heading: Password reset
documents.body: Users recover forgotten passwords using a one-time email link that expires in fifteen minutes.

documents.heading: API credentials
documents.body: API_TOKEN authenticates machine requests. Store credentials in environment variables and rotate them monthly.

documents.heading: Database recovery
documents.body: Restore the most recent database snapshot, then replay the write-ahead log to recover committed transactions.

documents.heading: Backups
documents.body: Database backups run nightly and are retained for thirty days in a separate region.

documents.heading: Rate limiting
documents.body: Each client may send one hundred requests per minute. Excess traffic receives HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header.

documents.heading: Request tracing
documents.body: Trace IDs connect logs across service boundaries. Include X-Trace-ID in every downstream request.

documents.heading: Cache invalidation
documents.body: Invalidate cached product records immediately after a successful write. Cache misses load records from the database.

documents.heading: Deploy rollback
documents.body: Roll back a failed deployment by routing traffic to the previous healthy image. Keep the database schema backward compatible.

documents.heading: Feature flags
documents.body: Feature flags enable a change for a small percentage of users before a full rollout. Disable the flag if error rates rise.

documents.heading: Message retries
documents.body: Failed queue messages use exponential backoff. After five attempts move the message to the dead-letter queue.

documents.heading: Idempotency
documents.body: Idempotency-Key identifies retried payment requests. Reuse the recorded response instead of charging the customer twice.

documents.heading: Image uploads
documents.body: Uploaded images are limited to ten megabytes. Decode and resize images before storing the resulting thumbnails.

documents.heading: Pagination
documents.body: List endpoints use opaque cursors. Pass next_cursor from the response to fetch the following page.

documents.heading: Connection pooling
documents.body: Reuse database connections through a pool of twenty connections per process. Queue requests while the pool is exhausted.

documents.heading: Health checks
documents.body: The readiness endpoint fails until the database connection is ready. Liveness only checks whether the process responds.

documents.heading: TLS certificates
documents.body: Renew TLS certificates automatically before expiry. Alert operators seven days before a certificate expires.

documents.heading: Audit logging
documents.body: Record permission changes and administrator actions in an append-only audit log with actor and timestamp.

documents.heading: Search configuration
documents.body: Set SEARCH_MIN_SIMILARITY to control the minimum semantic match. Lexical evidence can qualify independently.

documents.heading: Unicode handling
documents.body: Decode input as UTF-8 and preserve complete Unicode code points when splitting text. Never leave an unmatched surrogate.

documents.heading: Table exports
documents.body: CSV exports quote cells containing commas and escape embedded quotation marks by doubling them.

documents.heading: Webhooks
documents.body: Verify the webhook signature using the shared signing secret before processing the event payload.

documents.heading: Concurrency
documents.body: Writers acquire search-write.lock before publishing an index. Readers continue using the previous complete generation.
